title: Point pullback with its module categories recorded
statement: For a commutative condensed ring object Λ and a scheme Z [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data], pointModelPullbackFunctor Λ Z is the existing module functor (upperStarFromPoint Z).mapMod Λ from internal Λ-modules on the condensed point to internal p_Z^*Λ-modules. Its object and morphism maps are those of the existing functor.
